text: 10 OVERDOSAGE No drugs are approved for the treatment of pemetrexed for injection overdose. Based on animal studies, administration of leucovorin may mitigate the toxicities of pemetrexed for injection overdosage. It is not known whether pemetrexed is dialyzable.
